QuestInfo.name: The Ruse
QuestInfo.0: Ryden wants to brief you on the specific details of how to carry out the Kerning City infiltration mission.
QuestInfo.1: Your job is to infiltrate Kerning City, pretending to be a normal Thief and get close to the #bDark Lord#k. Then, you're to talk to the people in Kerning City about the Dark Lord and dig up some dirt on him...\r\n\r\n
QuestInfo.2: Your ruse seems to have worked. The Dark Lord thinks you're just another Thief.

0.0: On the outside, you look like just another one of Jin's Thieves. But inside, you have become a true Dual Blade. I congratulate you.
0.1: Now for your mission. #bGo to the Kerning City Jazz Bar and meet the Dark Lord#k. You'll need his blessing to become a Thief.
0.2: All you have to do is convince the Dark Lord that you're one of his. He can't possibly remember every Thief that crosses his path.
0.3: Then, once you have his blessing, chat up the folks in Kerning City. The Dark Lord is cunning, so dirt may be hard to find, but be persistent. Give us a lead, any lead, and I'll take care of the rest.

yes.0: When you have something to report, I will be in touch.

1.0: A Thief I've never met before?! Who are you?!\r\n#L0##bWe met just once, long ago, Dark Lord, when I had my first Job Advancement. But you meet so many Thieves, I'm not surprised you forgot.#l\n#k
1.1: Wrong. I have an excellent memory. It must've been a looong time ago, if I've forgotten who you are. And yet, look at how low your level is. Explain yourself! \r\n#L0##bI was taking care of my grandma in the hospital, so I had to delay my training. She's better now, by the way.#l\n#k
1.2: You should've trained when visiting hours were over. There is no excuse for your laziness. You must be whipped into shape.

npc.0: Your adventures as a spy in #bKerning City#k await! The Jazz Bar is very close to where we are, actually...
